notes: Sets the zero (0) base angle with respect to the current UCS.

name: ANGDIR
notes: Sets the direction of positive angles.

name: ANNOALLVISIBLE
notes: Hides or displays annotative objects that do not support the current annotation scale.

name: ANNOAUTOSCALE
notes: Updates annotative objects to support the annotation scale when the annotation scale is changed.

name: ANNOMONITOR

name: ANNOSCALEZOOM

name: ANNOTATIVEDWG

name: APBOX
notes: Turns the display of the AutoSnap aperture box on or off.

name: APERTURE
notes: Controls the size of the object target box.

name: APPAUTOLOAD
notes: Controls when plug-in applications are loaded.

name: APPLYGLOBALOPACITIES
notes: Applies transparency settings to all palettes.

name: APSTATE
notes: Indicates whether the Block Authoring Palettes window in the Block Editor is open or closed.

name: AREA
notes: Stores the last area computed by the AREA and MEASUREGEOM commands.

name: ARRAYASSOCIATIVITY
notes: Sets the default behavior of new arrays to be associative or nonassociative.

name: ARRAYEDITSTATE
notes: Indicates whether the drawing is in the array editing state, which is activated while editing an associative array's source objects.

name: ARRAYTYPE
notes: Specifies the default array type.

name: ASSISTANTSTATE
notes: Indicates whether the Autodesk Assistant palette is open, closed or hidden.

name: ATTDIA
notes: Controls whether the INSERT command uses a dialog box for attribute value entry.

name: ATTIPE
notes: Controls which Text Formatting toolbar is displayed with the in-place editor for modifying multiline attributes.

name: ATTMODE
notes: Controls display of attributes.

name: ATTMULTI
notes: Controls whether multiline attributes can be created.

name: ATTREQ
notes: Controls whether INSERT uses default attribute settings during insertion of blocks.

name: AUDITCTL
notes: Controls whether AUDIT creates an audit report (ADT) file.

name: AUNITS
notes: Sets units for angles.

name: AUPREC
notes: Sets the display precision for angular units and coordinates.

name: AUTODWFPUBLISH
notes: Controls whether DWF (Design Web Format) files are created automatically when you save or close drawing (DWG) files.

name: AUTOMATICPUB
notes: Controls whether electronic files (DWF/PDF) are created automatically when you save or close drawing (DWG) files.

name: AUTOPLACEMENT
notes: Controls whether placement suggestions are displayed as you insert a block.

name: AUTOSNAP
notes: Controls the display of the AutoSnap marker, tooltip, and magnet.

name: BACKGROUNDPLOT
notes: Controls whether background plotting is turned on or off for plotting and publishing.

name: BACKZ
notes: Stores the back clipping plane offset from the target plane for the current viewport, in drawing units.

name: BACTIONBARMODE
notes: Indicates whether the action bars or the legacy action objects are displayed in the Block Editor.

name: BACTIONCOLOR
notes: Sets the text color of actions in the Block Editor.

name: BCONSTATUSMODE
notes: Turns the constraint display status on and off and controls the shading of objects based on their constraint level.

name: BCONVERTLAYER
notes: Controls whether the object layer in the block definition will become Layer 0 after objects are converted into blocks.

name: BDEPENDENCYHIGHLIGHT
notes: Controls whether or not dependent objects are dependency highlighted when a parameter, action, or grip is selected in the Block Editor.

name: BGCOREPUBLISH
notes: Controls whether background publishing uses a single or multiple cores.

name: BGRIPOBJCOLOR
notes: Sets the color of grips in the Block Editor.

name: BGRIPOBJSIZE
notes: Sets the display size of custom grips in the Block Editor relative to the screen display.

name: BINDTYPE
notes: Specifies the default or controls the naming behavior to be applied to "named objects" in an xref when a bind or an edit-in-place operation is performed on it.

name: BLOCKCREATEMODE
notes: Sets the behavior for selected objects after creating blocks with the BLOCK and -BLOCK commands. The objects are either deleted, retained, or replaced with an instance of the block.

name: BLOCKEDITLOCK
notes: Disallows opening of the Block Editor and editing of dynamic block definitions.

name: BLOCKEDITOR
notes: Indicates whether or not the Block Editor is open.

name: BLOCKEXCLUDECOLOR
notes: Sets the color highlighting for identified instances that should not be converted into blocks.

name: BLOCKINCLUDECOLOR
notes: Sets the color highlighting for identified instances that can be converted into blocks.

name: BLOCKMRULIST
notes: Controls the number of most recently used blocks displayed in the Recent tab of the Blocks palette.

name: BLOCKNAVIGATE
notes: Controls the folder, file, and blocks that are displayed in the Libraries tab of the Blocks palette.

name: BLOCKREDEFINEMODE
notes: Controls whether a dialog box or a prompt on the command line displays when inserting a block from the Blocks palette with the same name as an existing block definition.

name: BLOCKSDATACOLLECTION
notes: Controls whether the content data used when working with smart blocks is shared to the data collection service.

name: BLOCKSRECENTFOLDER
notes: Sets the path where the recently inserted or created blocks are stored.

name: BLOCKSTATE
notes: Reports whether the Blocks palette is open or closed.

name: BLOCKSYNCFOLDER
notes: Sets the path where the recent and favorite blocks are stored.

name: BLOCKTARGETCOLOR
notes: Sets the color highlighting for the specified instance from which the new block definition is created.

name: BLOCKTESTWINDOW
notes: Indicates whether or not a test block window is current.

name: BPARAMETERCOLOR
notes: Sets the color of parameters in the Block Editor.

name: BPARAMETERFONT
notes: Sets the font used for parameters and actions in the Block Editor.

name: BPARAMETERSIZE
notes: Sets the size of parameter text and features in the Block Editor relative to the screen display.

name: BPTEXTHORIZONTAL
notes: Forces the text displayed for action parameters and constraint parameters in the Block Editor to be horizontal.

name: BSEARCHINCLUDEEXISTINGBLOCKS
notes: Controls whether existing block instances are selected by BSEARCH command by default. Users can still make adjustments to the selection during the review process.

name: BTMARKDISPLAY
notes: Controls whether or not value set markers are displayed for dynamic block references.

name: BVMODE
notes: Controls how objects that are made invisible for the current visibility state are displayed in the Block Editor.

name: CACHEMAXFILES
notes: Sets the upper-limit to the number of drawing file entries that can be kept in the product graphics cache.

name: CACHEMAXTOTALSIZE
notes: Sets the upper-limit in megabytes (Mbs) for all drawing file entries in the product graphics cache.

name: CALCINPUT
notes: Controls whether mathematical expressions and global constants are evaluated in text and numeric entry boxes of windows and dialog boxes.

name: CAMERADISPLAY
notes: out of scope under SD-05

name: CAMERAHEIGHT
notes: Specifies the default height for new camera objects.

name: CANNOSCALE
notes: Sets the name of the current annotation scale for the current space.

name: CANNOSCALEVALUE
notes: Displays the value of the current annotation scale.

name: CAPTURETHUMBNAILS
notes: Specifies if and when thumbnails are captured for the Rewind tool.

name: CBARTRANSPARENCY
notes: Controls the transparency of the constraint bars.

name: CCONSTRAINTFORM
notes: Controls whether annotational or dynamic constraints are applied to objects.

name: CDATE
notes: Stores the current date and time in coded decimal format.

name: CECOLOR
notes: Sets the color of new objects as you create them.

name: CELTSCALE
notes: Sets the current object linetype scaling factor.

name: CELTYPE
notes: Sets the linetype of new objects.

name: CELWEIGHT
notes: Sets the lineweight of new objects.

name: CENTERCROSSGAP
notes: Determines the gap between the center mark and its centerlines.

name: CENTERCROSSSIZE
notes: Determines the size of the associative center mark.

name: CENTEREXE
notes: Controls the length of the centerline extensions.

name: CENTERLAYER
notes: Specifies a default layer for new center marks or centerlines.

name: CENTERLTSCALE
notes: Sets the linetype scale used by center marks and centerlines.

name: CENTERLTYPE
notes: Specifies the linetype used by center marks and centerlines.

name: CENTERLTYPEFILE
notes: Specifies the loaded linetype library file used to create center marks and centerlines.

name: CENTERMARKEXE
notes: Determines whether centerlines extend automatically from new center marks.

name: CENTERMT
notes: Controls how grips stretch multiline text that is centered horizontally.

name: CETRANSPARENCY
notes: Sets the transparency level for new objects.

name: CGEOCS
notes: Stores the name of the GIS coordinate system assigned to the drawing file.

name: CHAMFERA
notes: Sets the first chamfer distance when CHAMMODE is set to 0.

name: CHAMFERB
notes: Sets the second chamfer distance when CHAMMODE is set to 0.

name: CHAMFERC
notes: Sets the chamfer length when CHAMMODE is set to 1.

name: CHAMFERD
notes: Sets the chamfer angle when CHAMMODE is set to 1.

name: CHAMMODE
notes: Sets the input method for CHAMFER.

name: CIRCLERAD
notes: Sets the default circle radius.

name: CLAYER
notes: Sets the current layer.

name: CLAYOUT
notes: Sets the current layout.

name: CLEANSCREENSTATE
notes: Indicates whether the clean screen state is on or off.

name: CLIPROMPTLINES
notes: Sets how many temporary prompt lines for a single command are displayed above the command window.

name: CLIPROMPTUPDATE
notes: Controls whether the command line displays the messages and prompts generated while an AutoLISP or script file is being executed.

name: CLISTATE
notes: Indicates whether the command line is open or closed.

name: CMATERIAL
notes: out of scope under SD-05

name: CMDACTIVE
notes: Indicates whether an ordinary command, transparent command, script, or dialog box is active.

name: CMDDIA
notes: Controls the display of the In-Place Text Editor for the DIMEDIT and QLEADER commands, and the display of certain dialog boxes in AutoCAD-based products.

name: CMDECHO
notes: Controls whether prompts and input are echoed during the AutoLISP command function.

name: CMDINPUTHISTORYMAX
notes: Sets the maximum number of previous input values that are stored for a prompt in a command.

name: CMDNAMES
notes: Displays the names of the active and transparent commands.

name: CMFADECOLOR
notes: Controls the amount of black blended on all attached coordination models.

name: CMFADEOPACITY
notes: Controls the amount of dimming through transparency for all attached coordination models.

name: CMLEADERSTYLE
notes: Sets the name of the current multileader style.

name: CMLJUST
notes: Specifies multiline justification.

name: CMLSCALE
notes: Controls the overall width of a multiline.

name: CMLSTYLE
notes: Sets the multiline style that governs the appearance of the multiline.

name: CMOSNAP
notes: Determines whether object snapping is active for geometry in coordination models that are attached to the drawing.

name: COLORTHEME
notes: Sets the color theme of the ribbon, palettes, and several other interface elements to dark or light.

name: COMMANDMACROSSTATE
notes: Indicates whether the Command Macros palette is open or closed.

name: COMMANDPREVIEW
notes: Controls whether a preview of the possible outcome of certain commands is displayed.

name: COMMENTHIGHLIGHT
notes: Controls the display of markup assist boundaries for comments attached to PDF markups.

name: COMPARECOLOR1
notes: Sets the color of the objects that only exist in the first drawing in the comparison drawing.

name: COMPARECOLOR2
notes: Sets the color of the objects that only exist in the second drawing in the comparison result drawing.

name: COMPARECOLORCOMMON
notes: Sets the color of the objects that are identical in the two drawings being compared.

name: COMPAREFRONT
notes: Controls the default display order of overlapping objects in the comparison drawing.

name: COMPAREHATCH
notes: Controls whether hatch objects are included in the drawing comparison.

name: COMPAREPROPS
notes: Controls whether a change in an object's property is identified as a change between two drawings revisions.

name: COMPARERCMARGIN
notes: Specifies the offset distance between the boundary of a change set and the rectangle/polygonal revision cloud in the comparison drawing.

name: COMPARERCSHAPE
notes: Controls whether nearby individual changes are merged as a single large rectangle or a series of smaller rectangles in the compare result drawing.

name: COMPARESHOW1
notes: Displays the objects that exist only in the first drawing.

name: COMPARESHOW2
notes: Displays the objects that exist only in the second drawing.

name: COMPARESHOWCOMMON
notes: Displays the objects that are identical in both the drawings that are being compared.

name: COMPARESHOWCONTEXT
notes: Controls the visibility of objects that are not used in the xref comparison.

name: COMPARESHOWRC
notes: Controls the display of revision cloud around the differences (change set) in the comparison drawing.

name: COMPARETEXT
notes: Controls whether text objects are included in the drawing comparison.

name: COMPARETOLERANCE
notes: Specifies the tolerance used when comparing two drawing files. Objects are considered identical if they are below or equal to a specified decimal point value.

name: COMPASS
notes: out of scope under SD-05

name: COMPLEXLTPREVIEW
notes: Controls whether a preview of the complex linetype is displayed during interactive operations.

name: CONSTRAINTBARDISPLAY
notes: Controls the display of constraints bars for subsequently applied geometric constraints, and the display of hidden constraints for selected objects.

name: CONSTRAINTBARMODE
notes: Controls the display of geometric constraints on constraint bars.

name: CONSTRAINTINFER
notes: Controls whether the geometric constraints are inferred while creating and editing geometry.

name: CONSTRAINTNAMEFORMAT
notes: Controls the text format for dimensional constraints.

name: CONSTRAINTSOLVEMODE
notes: Controls constraint behavior when applying or editing constraints.

name: COORDS
notes: Controls whether the cursor position on the status bar is updated continuously or at specific times only. It also controls the format in which the coordinates are displayed.

name: COPYMODE
notes: Controls whether the COPY command repeats automatically.

name: COUNTCHECK
notes: Controls the types of errors to check in the count.

name: COUNTCOLOR
notes: Sets the highlighting color on objects in a count.

name: COUNTERRORCOLOR
notes: Sets the highlighting color on objects that can cause potential errors in a count.

name: COUNTERRORNUM
notes: Displays the number errors in the current count.

name: COUNTNUMBER
notes: Displays the number of the current count.

name: COUNTPALETTESTATE
notes: Reports whether the Count palette is open or closed.

name: COUNTSERVICE
notes: Controls the background indexing of the count.

name: CPLOTSTYLE
notes: Controls the current plot style for new objects.

name: CPROFILE
notes: Displays the name of the current profile.

name: CROSSINGAREACOLOR
notes: Controls the color of the selection area during crossing selection.

name: CTAB
notes: Determines whether the drawing area displays the Model tab or a specified layout tab.

name: CTABLESTYLE
notes: Sets the name of the current table style.

name: CULLINGOBJ
notes: out of scope under SD-05

name: CULLINGOBJSELECTION
notes: out of scope under SD-05

name: CURSORBADGE
notes: Determines whether certain cursor badges are displayed in the drawing area.

name: CURSORSIZE
notes: Determines the size of the crosshairs as a percentage of the screen size.

name: CURSORTYPE
notes: Determines the cursor displayed by your pointing device.

name: CVIEWDETAILSTYLE
notes: Sets the name of the current detail view style. The current detail view style controls the appearance of all new model documentation detail views, detail boundaries and leader lines you create.

name: CVIEWSECTIONSTYLE
notes: Sets the name of the current section view style. The current section view style controls the appearance of all new model documentation section views and section lines you create.

name: CVPORT
notes: Displays the identification number of the current viewport.

name: DATALINKNOTIFY
notes: Controls the notification for updated or missing data links.

name: DATE
notes: Stores the current date and time in Modified Julian Date format.

name: DBCSTATE
notes: Indicates whether the dbConnect Manager is open or closed.

name: DBLCLKEDIT
notes: Controls the double click editing behavior in the drawing area.

name: DBMOD
notes: Indicates the drawing modification status.

name: DCTCUST
notes: Displays the path and file name of the current custom spelling dictionary.

name: DCTMAIN
notes: Displays the three letter keyword for the current main spelling dictionary.

name: DEFAULTGIZMO
notes: out of scope under SD-05

name: DEFAULTLIGHTING
notes: Turns on and off default lighting in place of other lighting.

name: DEFAULTLIGHTINGTYPE
notes: Specifies the type of default lighting, old or new.

name: DEFLPLSTYLE
notes: Specifies the default plot style for all layers in a drawing when opening a drawing that was created in a release prior to AutoCAD 2000, or for Layer 0 when creating a new drawing from scratch without using a drawing template.

name: DEFPLSTYLE
notes: Specifies the default plot style for new objects in a drawing when opening a drawing that was created in a release prior to AutoCAD 2000, or when creating a new drawing from scratch without using a drawing template.

name: DELOBJ
notes: Controls whether geometry used to create other objects is retained or deleted.

name: DEMANDLOAD
notes: Specifies if and when to demand-load certain applications.

name: DGNFRAME
notes: Determines whether DGN underlay frames are visible or plotted in the current drawing.

name: DGNIMPORTMAX
notes: Sets the maximum number of elements that are translated when importing a DGN file.

name: DGNIMPORTMODE
notes: Controls the default behavior of the DGNIMPORT command.

name: DGNMAPPINGPATH
notes: Specifies the location of the dgnsetups.ini file where DGN mapping setups are stored.

name: DGNOSNAP
notes: Determines whether object snapping is active for geometry in DGN underlays that are attached to the drawing.

name: DIASTAT
notes: Stores the exit method of the most recently used dialog box.

name: DIGITIZER
notes: Identifies digitizers connected to the system.

name: DIMADEC
notes: Controls the number of precision places displayed in angular dimensions.

name: DIMALT
notes: Controls the display of alternate units in dimensions.

name: DIMALTD
notes: Controls the number of decimal places in alternate units.

name: DIMALTF
notes: Controls the multiplier for alternate units.

name: DIMALTRND
notes: Rounds off the alternate dimension units.

name: DIMALTTD
notes: Sets the number of decimal places for the tolerance values in the alternate units of a dimension.

name: DIMALTTZ
notes: Controls suppression of zeros in tolerance values.

name: DIMALTU
notes: Sets the units format for alternate units of all dimension substyles except Angular.

name: DIMALTZ
notes: Controls the suppression of zeros for alternate unit dimension values.

name: DIMANNO
notes: Indicates whether or not the current dimension style is annotative.

name: DIMAPOST
notes: Specifies a text prefix or suffix (or both) to the alternate dimension measurement for all types of dimensions except angular.

name: DIMARCSYM
notes: Controls display of the arc symbol in an arc length dimension.

name: DIMASSOC
notes: Controls the associativity of dimension objects and whether dimensions are exploded.

name: DIMASZ
notes: Controls the size of dimension line and leader line arrowheads. Also controls the size of hook lines.

name: DIMATFIT
notes: Determines how dimension text and arrows are arranged when space is not sufficient to place both within the extension lines.

name: DIMAUNIT
notes: Sets the units format for angular dimensions.

name: DIMAZIN
notes: Suppresses zeros for angular dimensions.

name: DIMBLK
notes: Sets the arrowhead block displayed at the ends of dimension lines.

name: DIMBLK1
notes: Sets the arrowhead for the first end of the dimension line when DIMSAH is on.

name: DIMBLK2
notes: Sets the arrowhead for the second end of the dimension line when DIMSAH is on.

name: DIMCEN
notes: Controls drawing of circle or arc center marks and centerlines by the DIMCENTER, DIMDIAMETER, and DIMRADIUS commands.

name: DIMCLRD
notes: Assigns colors to dimension lines, arrowheads, and dimension leader lines.

name: DIMCLRE
notes: Assigns colors to extension lines, center marks, and centerlines.

name: DIMCLRT
notes: Assigns colors to dimension text.

name: DIMCONSTRAINTICON
notes: Controls the display of the lock icon for dimensional constraints.

name: DIMCONTINUEMODE
notes: Determines whether the dimension style and layer of a continued or baseline dimension is inherited from the dimension that is being continued.

name: DIMDEC
notes: Sets the number of decimal places displayed for the primary units of a dimension.

name: DIMDLE
notes: Sets the distance the dimension line extends beyond the extension line when oblique strokes are drawn instead of arrowheads.

name: DIMDLI
notes: Controls the spacing of the dimension lines in baseline dimensions.

name: DIMDSEP
notes: Specifies a single-character decimal separator to use when creating dimensions whose unit format is decimal.

name: DIMEXE
notes: Specifies how far to extend the extension line beyond the dimension line.

name: DIMEXO
notes: Specifies how far extension lines are offset from origin points.

name: DIMFRAC
notes: Sets the fraction format when DIMLUNIT is set to 4 (Architectural) or 5 (Fractional).

name: DIMFXL
notes: Sets the total length of the extension lines starting from the dimension line toward the dimension origin.

name: DIMFXLON
notes: Controls whether extension lines are set to a fixed length.

name: DIMGAP
notes: Sets the distance around the dimension text when the dimension line breaks to accommodate dimension text.

name: DIMJOGANG
notes: Determines the angle of the transverse segment of the dimension line in a jogged radius dimension.

name: DIMJUST
notes: Controls the horizontal positioning of dimension text.

name: DIMLAYER
notes: Specifies a default layer for new dimensions.

name: DIMLDRBLK
notes: Specifies the arrow type for leaders.

name: DIMLFAC
notes: Sets a scale factor for linear dimension measurements.

name: DIMLIM
notes: Generates dimension limits as the default text.

name: DIMLTEX1
notes: Sets the linetype of the first extension line.

name: DIMLTEX2
notes: Sets the linetype of the second extension line.

name: DIMLTYPE
notes: Sets the linetype of the dimension line.

name: DIMLUNIT
notes: Sets units for all dimension types except Angular.

name: DIMLWD
notes: Assigns lineweight to dimension lines.

name: DIMLWE
notes: Assigns lineweight to extension lines.

name: DIMPICKBOX
notes: Sets the object selection target height, in pixels, within the DIM command.

name: DIMPOST
notes: Specifies a text prefix or suffix (or both) to the dimension measurement.

name: DIMRND
notes: Rounds all dimensioning distances to the specified value.

name: DIMSAH
notes: Controls the display of dimension line arrowhead blocks.

name: DIMSCALE
notes: Sets the overall scale factor applied to dimensioning variables that specify sizes, distances, or offsets.

name: DIMSD1
notes: Controls suppression of the first dimension line and arrowhead.

name: DIMSD2
notes: Controls suppression of the second dimension line and arrowhead.

name: DIMSE1
notes: Suppresses display of the first extension line.

name: DIMSE2
notes: Suppresses display of the second extension line.

name: DIMSOXD
notes: Suppresses arrowheads if not enough space is available inside the extension lines.

name: DIMSTYLE
notes: Displays the unit type (imperial/standard or ISO-25/metric) used by dimensions in the drawing.

name: DIMTAD
notes: Controls the vertical position of text in relation to the dimension line.

name: DIMTDEC
notes: Sets the number of decimal places to display in tolerance values for the primary units in a dimension.

name: DIMTFAC
notes: Specifies a scale factor for the text height of fractions and tolerance values relative to the dimension text height, as set by DIMTXT.

name: DIMTFILL
notes: Controls the background of dimension text.

name: DIMTFILLCLR
notes: Sets the color for the text background in dimensions.

name: DIMTIH
notes: Controls the position of dimension text inside the extension lines for all dimension types except Ordinate.

name: DIMTIX
notes: Draws text between extension lines.

name: DIMTM
notes: Sets the minimum (or lower) tolerance limit for dimension text when DIMTOL or DIMLIM is on.

name: DIMTMOVE
notes: Sets dimension text movement rules.

name: DIMTOFL
notes: Controls whether a dimension line is drawn between the extension lines even when the text is placed outside.

name: DIMTOH
notes: Controls the position of dimension text outside the extension lines.

name: DIMTOL
notes: Appends tolerances to dimension text.

name: DIMTOLJ
notes: Sets the vertical justification for tolerance values relative to the nominal dimension text.

name: DIMTP
notes: Sets the maximum (or upper) tolerance limit for dimension text when DIMTOL or DIMLIM is on.

name: DIMTSZ
notes: Specifies the size of oblique strokes drawn instead of arrowheads for linear, radius, and diameter dimensioning.

name: DIMTVP
notes: Controls the vertical position of dimension text above or below the dimension line.

name: DIMTXSTY
notes: Specifies the text style of the dimension.

name: DIMTXT
notes: Specifies the height of dimension text, unless the current text style has a fixed height.

name: DIMTXTDIRECTION
notes: Specifies the reading direction of the dimension text.

name: DIMTXTRULER
notes: Controls the display of the ruler when editing a dimension text.

name: DIMTZIN
notes: Controls the suppression of zeros in tolerance values.

name: DIMUPT
notes: Controls options for user-positioned text.

name: DIMZIN
notes: Controls the suppression of zeros in the primary unit value.

name: DISPSILH
notes: Controls display of silhouette edges of 3D solid and surface objects in the Wireframe or 2D Wireframe visual styles.

name: DISPSILHBLOCKS
notes: Controls the display of 3D solid silhouettes in blocks in the 2D Wireframe visual style.

name: DISTANCE
notes: Stores the distance computed by the DIST command.

notes: Sets the number of subdivisions for the height of a mesh box along the Z axis.

name: DIVMESHBOXLENGTH
notes: Sets the number of subdivisions for the length of a mesh box along the X axis.

name: DIVMESHBOXWIDTH
notes: Sets the number of subdivisions for the width of a mesh box along the Y axis.

notes: Sets the number of subdivisions around the perimeter of the mesh cone base.

name: DIVMESHCONEBASE
notes: Sets the number of subdivisions between the perimeter and the center point of the mesh cone base.

name: DIVMESHCONEHEIGHT
notes: Sets the number of subdivisions between the base and the point or top of the mesh cone.

notes: Sets the number of subdivisions around the perimeter of the mesh cylinder base.

notes: Sets the number of radial subdivisions from the center of the mesh cylinder base to its perimeter.

name: DIVMESHCYLHEIGHT
notes: Sets the number of subdivisions between the base and the top of the mesh cylinder.

notes: Sets the number of subdivisions between the base and the top of the mesh pyramid.

notes: Sets the number of subdivisions in the profile that sweeps the path of a mesh torus.

notes: Sets the number of subdivisions for the height of the mesh wedge along the Z axis.

name: DIVMESHWEDGELENGTH
notes: Sets the number of subdivisions for the length of a mesh wedge along the X axis.

name: DIVMESHWEDGESLOPE
notes: Sets the number of subdivisions in the slope that extends from the apex of the wedge to the edge of the base.

name: DIVMESHWEDGEWIDTH
notes: Sets the number of subdivisions for the width of the mesh wedge along the Y axis.

name: DONUTID

name: DONUTOD
notes: Sets the default for the outside diameter of a donut.

name: DRAGMODE
notes: Controls the way dragged objects are displayed.

notes: When software acceleration is used, controls how many vectors the system draws when you drag objects within a 2D viewport before it checks for a new input sample from the mouse.

name: DRAWORDERCTL
notes: Controls the default display behavior of overlapping objects when they are created or edited.

name: DTEXTED

name: TRIMEXTENDMODE
notes: Controls whether the TRIM and EXTEND commands use streamlined inputs.

name: TRIMMODE
notes: Controls whether selected edges for chamfers and fillets are trimmed.

name: TRUSTEDPATHS
notes: Specifies which folders have permission to load and execute files that contain code.

name: TSPACEFAC
notes: Controls the multiline text line-spacing distance measured as a factor of text height.

name: TSPACETYPE
notes: Controls the type of line spacing used in multiline text.

name: TSTACKALIGN
notes: Controls the vertical alignment of stacked text.

name: TSTACKSIZE
notes: Controls the percentage of stacked text fraction height relative to selected text's current height.

name: UCS2DDISPLAYSETTING
notes: Displays the UCS icon when the 2D Wireframe visual style is current.

name: UCS3DPARADISPLAYSETTING
notes: Displays the UCS icon when perspective view is off and a 3D visual style is current.

name: UCS3DPERPDISPLAYSETTING
notes: Displays the UCS icon when perspective view is on and a 3D visual style is current.

name: UCSAXISANG
notes: Stores the default angle when rotating the UCS around one of its axes using the X, Y, or Z option of the UCS command.

name: UCSBASE
notes: Stores the name of the UCS that defines the origin and orientation of orthographic UCS settings.

name: UCSDETECT
notes: Controls whether dynamic UCS acquisition is active when creating objects involving 3D planar surfaces.

name: UCSFOLLOW
notes: Generates a plan view whenever you change from one UCS to another.

name: UCSICON
notes: Controls the visibility and placement of the UCS icon.

name: UCSNAME
notes: Stores the name of the current user coordinate system for the current viewport in the current space.

name: UCSORG
notes: Stores the origin point of the current user coordinate system for the current viewport in the current space.

name: UCSORTHO
notes: Determines whether the XY plane of the UCS is automatically aligned with the plane of the current view when an orthographic view is restored.

name: UCSSELECTMODE
notes: Controls whether the UCS icon can be selected and manipulated with grips.

name: UCSVIEW
notes: Determines whether the current UCS is saved with a named view.

name: UCSVP
notes: Determines whether the UCSs in other viewports are dependent or independent of the UCS of the current viewport.

name: UCSXDIR
notes: Stores the X direction of the current UCS for the current viewport in the current space.

name: UCSYDIR
notes: Stores the Y direction of the current UCS for the current viewport in the current space.

name: UNDOCTL
notes: Displays the options used in the UNDO command.

name: UNDOMARKS
notes: Displays the number of marks placed in the UNDO control stream.

name: UNITMODE
notes: Controls the display format for units.

name: UOSNAP
notes: Determines whether object snaps are available for geometry in DWF, DWFx, PDF, and DGN underlays.

name: UPDATETHUMBNAIL
notes: Controls updating of the thumbnail previews for views and layouts.

name: USERI1-5
notes: Provides storage and retrieval of integer values.

name: USERR1-5
notes: Provides storage and retrieval of real numbers.

name: USERS1-5
notes: Provides storage and retrieval of text string data.

name: VIEWBACKSTATUS
notes: Stores whether a previous view is available for the VIEWBACK command.

name: VIEWCTR
notes: Stores the center of the view in the current viewport.

name: VIEWDIR
notes: Stores the viewing direction in the current viewport, expressed in UCS coordinates.

name: VIEWFWDSTATUS
notes: Stores whether a previous view is available for the VIEWFORWARD command.

name: VIEWMODE
notes: Stores the view settings for the current viewport.

name: VIEWPORTLAYER
notes: Specifies a default layer for new viewports.

name: VIEWSIZE
notes: Stores the height of the view displayed in the current viewport, measured in drawing units.

name: VIEWSKETCHMODE
notes: Indicates whether the system is in symbol sketch mode or not.

name: VIEWTWIST
notes: Stores the view rotation angle for the current viewport measured relative to the WCS.

name: VIEWUPDATEAUTO
notes: Controls whether model documentation drawing views are updated automatically when the source model changes.

name: VISRETAIN
notes: Controls the properties of xref-dependent layers.

name: VISRETAINMODE
notes: Controls the behavior of the VISRETAIN system variable when it's set to 1.

name: VPCONTROL
notes: Controls whether the options for viewports, views, and visual styles are displayed in the upper-left corner of every viewport.

name: VPLAYEROVERRIDES
notes: Indicates if there are any layers with viewport (VP) property overrides for the current layout viewport.

name: VPLAYEROVERRIDESMODE
notes: Controls whether layer property overrides for layout viewports are displayed and plotted.

name: VPMAXIMIZEDSTATE
notes: Indicates whether the viewport is maximized or not.

name: VPROTATEASSOC
notes: Controls whether the view within a viewport is rotated with the viewport when the viewport is rotated.

name: VSACURVATUREHIGH
notes: Sets the value at which a surface displays as green during curvature analysis (ANALYSISCURVATURE).

name: VSACURVATURELOW
notes: Sets the value at which a surface displays as blue during curvature analysis (ANALYSISCURVATURE).

name: VSACURVATURETYPE
notes: Controls which type of curvature analysis is used with the (ANALYSISCURVATURE).

name: VSADRAFTANGLEHIGH
notes: Sets the value at which a model displays as green during draft analysis (ANALYSISDRAFT).

name: VSADRAFTANGLELOW
notes: Sets the value at which a model displays as blue during draft analysis (ANALYSISDRAFT).

name: VSAZEBRACOLOR1
notes: Sets the first color of the zebra stripes displayed during zebra analysis (ANALYSISZEBRA).

name: VSAZEBRACOLOR2
notes: Sets the second (contrasting) color of the zebra stripes displayed during zebra analysis (ANALYSISZEBRA).

name: VSAZEBRADIRECTION
notes: Controls whether zebra stripes display horizontally, vertically, or at an angle during zebra analysis (ANALYSISBRA).

name: VSAZEBRASIZE
notes: Controls the width of the zebra stripes displayed during zebra analysis (ANALYSISZEBRA).

name: VSAZEBRATYPE
notes: Sets the type of zebra display when using zebra analysis (ANALYSISZEBRA).

name: VSBACKGROUNDS
notes: Controls whether backgrounds are displayed in the visual style applied to the current viewport.

name: VSEDGECOLOR
notes: Sets the color of edges in the visual style in the current viewport.

name: VSEDGEJITTER
notes: Makes the edges on objects appear with several linear strokes, as though they were sketched with a pencil.

name: VSEDGELEX
notes: Controls the number of pixels that lines and edges appear to extend beyond their endpoints for a hand-drawn effect.

name: VSEDGEOVERHANG
notes: Obsolete. Replaced by the VSOCCLUDEDCOLOR system variable.

name: VSEDGES
notes: Controls the types of edges that are displayed in the viewport.

name: VSEDGESMOOTH
notes: Specifies the angle at which crease edges are displayed.

name: VSFACECOLORMODE
notes: Controls how the color of faces is calculated.

name: VSFACEHIGHLIGHT
notes: Controls the display of specular highlights on faces without materials in the current viewport.

name: VSFACEOPACITY
notes: Turns on and off a preset level of transparency for 3D objects.

name: VSFACESTYLE
notes: Controls how faces, solid-fill hatches, and gradients are displayed in the current viewport.

name: VSHALOGAP
notes: Sets the halo gap in the visual style applied to the current viewport.

name: VSHIDEPRECISION
notes: Obsolete. Controls the accuracy of hides and shades in the visual style applied to the current viewport.

name: VSINTERSECTIONCOLOR
notes: Sets the color of the intersections of independent 3D solids, surfaces, and meshes for a visual style.

name: VSINTERSECTIONEDGES
notes: Controls the display of the intersections of independent 3D solids, surfaces, and meshes for a visual style.

name: VSINTERSECTIONLTYPE
notes: Sets the linetype of the intersections of independent 3D solids, surfaces, and meshes for a visual style.

name: VSISOONTOP
notes: Displays isolines on top of shaded objects in the visual style applied to the current viewport.

name: VSLIGHTINGQUALITY
notes: Sets the lighting quality in the current viewport.

name: VSMATERIALMODE
notes: Controls the display of materials in the current viewport.

name: VSMAX
notes: Stores the upper-right corner of the current viewport's virtual screen.

name: VSMIN
notes: Stores the lower-left corner of the current viewport's virtual screen.

name: VSMONOCOLOR
notes: Sets the color for monochrome and tint display of faces in the visual style applied to the current viewport.

name: VSOBSCUREDCOLOR
notes: Obsolete. Replaced by the VSOCCLUDEDCOLOR system variable.

name: VSOBSCUREDEDGES
notes: Obsolete. Replaced by the VSOCCLUDEDEDGES system variable.

name: VSOBSCUREDLTYPE
notes: Obsolete. Replaced by the VSOCCLUDEDLTYPE system variable.

name: VSOCCLUDEDCOLOR
notes: Specifies the color of hidden lines displayed for a visual style.

name: VSOCCLUDEDEDGES
notes: Controls whether hidden edges are displayed for a visual style.

name: VSOCCLUDEDLTYPE
notes: Specifies the linetype of hidden lines displayed for a visual style.

name: VSSHADOWS
notes: Controls whether a visual style displays shadows.

name: VSSILHEDGES
notes: Controls display of silhouette edges of solid objects in the visual style applied to the current viewport.

name: VSSILHWIDTH
notes: Specifies the width in pixels of silhouette edges in the current viewport.

name: VSSTATE
notes: Indicates whether the Visual Styles window is open or closed.

name: VTDURATION
notes: Sets the duration of a smooth view transition, in milliseconds.

name: VTENABLE
notes: Controls when smooth view transitions are used.

name: VTFPS
notes: Sets the minimum speed of a smooth view transition, in frames per second.

name: WBLOCKCREATEMODE
notes: Sets the behavior for selected objects after saving the blocks as a file with the WBLOCK and -WBLOCK commands.

name: WHIPARC
notes: Controls how circles and arcs are displayed.

name: WHIPTHREAD
notes: Controls whether to use an additional processor to improve the speed of certain operations such as those that regenerate the drawing.

name: WINDOWAREACOLOR
notes: Controls the color of the transparent selection area during window selection.

name: WIPEOUTFRAME
notes: Controls the display of frames for wipeout objects.

name: WMFBKGND
notes: Controls the background display when objects are inserted in Windows metafile (WMF) format.

name: WMFFOREGND
notes: Controls the assignment of the foreground color when objects are inserted in Windows metafile (WMF) format.

name: WORKINGFOLDER
notes: Stores the drive and folder path of the operating system's working folder for the process, which can be of interest to developers.

name: WORKSPACELABEL
notes: Controls whether to display the name of the current workspace in the status bar.

name: WORLDUCS
notes: Indicates whether the UCS is coincident with the WCS.

name: WORLDVIEW
notes: Determines whether input to the DVIEW and VPOINT commands is relative to the WCS (default) or the current UCS.

name: WRITESTAT
notes: Indicates whether a drawing file is read-only or can be revised.

name: WSAUTOSAVE
notes: Saves changes you made to a workspace when you switch to another workspace.

name: WSCURRENT
notes: Displays the current workspace name at the Command prompt and sets a specified workspace to be the current one.

name: XCLIPFRAME
notes: Determines whether xref clipping boundaries are visible or plotted in the current drawing.

name: XCOMPAREBAKPATH
notes: Specifies the path where the backup xref file is stored.

name: XCOMPAREBAKSIZE
notes: Sets the size of the folder where the backup xref file is stored.

name: XCOMPARECOLORMODE
notes: Switches the visual effect of objects in the host drawing during an xref comparison.

name: XCOMPAREENABLE
notes: Enables the comparison between an xref and the referenced drawing file.

name: XDWGFADECTL
notes: Controls the dimming for all DWG xref objects.

name: XEDIT
notes: Controls whether the current drawing can be edited in-place when being referenced by another drawing.

name: XFADECTL
notes: Controls the amount of fading within a reference being edited in place. This setting affects only the objects that are not being edited in the reference.

name: XLOADCTL
notes: Turns xref demand-loading on and off, and controls whether it opens the referenced drawing or a copy.

name: XLOADPATH
notes: Creates a path for storing temporary copies of demand-loaded xref files.

name: XREFCTL
notes: Controls whether external reference log (XLG) files are created.

name: XREFLAYER
notes: Specifies a default layer for a new xref.

name: XREFNOTIFY
notes: Controls the notification for updated or missing xrefs.

name: XREFOVERRIDE
notes: Controls the display of object properties on referenced layers.

name: XREFREGAPPCTL
notes: Controls whether the registered application (RegApp) records stored in an xref being loaded are copied to the host drawing.

name: XREFTYPE
notes: Controls the default reference type when attaching or overlaying an external reference.

name: ZOOMFACTOR
notes: Controls how much the magnification changes when the mouse wheel moves forward or backward.

name: ZOOMWHEEL
notes: Toggles the direction of transparent zoom operations when you scroll the middle mouse wheel.
